motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Button fill feedback; disabled under reduced motion.

components.name: Primary button
components.css: .ds-primary { font: 600 1rem system-ui; color: var(--color-surface, #fff); background: var(--color-ink, #182733); border: 1px solid var(--color-ink, #182733); border-radius: var(--radius-control, 6px); padding: 10px 16px; min-height: 44px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-primary:hover { background: #2d4354; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-focus, #6553a6); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-primary:disabled { opacity: .58; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary button
components.css: .ds-secondary { font: 600 1rem system-ui; background: var(--color-surface, #fff); color: var(--color-ink, #182733); border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #becad2); border-radius: var(--radius-control, 6px); padding: 10px 16px; min-height: 44px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-secondary:hover { background: #e1e8ed; } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-focus, #6553a6); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Name field
components.html: <label class="ds-label">Your name<input class="ds-input" placeholder="The name your friends know"></label>
components.css: .ds-label { display: grid; gap: 8px; font: 600 1rem system-ui; color: var(--color-ink, #182733); } .ds-input { font: 400 1rem system-ui; color: var(--color-ink, #182733); background: var(--color-surface, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #becad2); border-radius: var(--radius-control, 6px); padding: 10px 12px; min-height: 44px; caret-color: var(--color-ink, #182733); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-muted, #536572); opacity: 1; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-focus, #6553a6); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Player role control
components.description: Native select with a player-specific accessible label.
components.css: .ds-role-label { display: grid; gap: 8px; font: 600 1rem system-ui; } .ds-role { font: 400 .875rem system-ui; background: var(--color-surface, #fff); color: var(--color-ink, #182733); border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #becad2); border-radius: var(--radius-control, 6px); padding: 8px 4px; min-height: 44px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-role:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-focus, #6553a6); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-role:disabled { opacity: .58; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Team heading
components.description: Explicit team text paired with semantic color.
components.html:
Red team

One spymaster · at least one operative
components.css: .ds-red { background: var(--color-red-surface, #fff1f1); color: var(--color-ink, #182733); padding: 24px; border-radius: var(--radius-control, 6px); font: 400 1rem system-ui; } .ds-red h2 { color: var(--color-red, #a52b36); font-size: 1.35rem; margin: 0 0 16px; } .ds-red p { margin: 0; }

narrative.overview: A clear shared table for friends: pale slate ground, white controls, readable dark type and explicit Red and Blue teams. Flat surfaces and native controls keep attention on the group.

rules.name: Visible focus
rules.body: Use a 3px Violet outline with a 3px offset without changing layout.

dos: Keep team names paired with color.
Preserve native keyboard and touch behavior.
donts: Do not add nested panels or decorative shadows.
Do not imply planned game UI is implemented.
